title: Daily Chief Inspector Report
contractor: Not recorded (project lead to be identified)

sections.heading: Summary of the Day
paragraphs: Field work coordination meeting held with the contractor to set reporting, documentation and safety expectations for the Titan 1 Flare / VRU scope. The team agreed on 07:00 CT as the official start time. The contractor reported fabrication on 11/20–11/21 and the start of civil layout today, with the one-call already made. Additional personnel arrive next week as materials become available; platforms are en route.

The contractor issued the Titan 1 Flare scatter sheet for 11/20–11/25: material receiving and MTR review, piping fabrication and welding daily, MPS layout 11/21 and all other foundation layouts 11/23, and foundation rebar starting 11/24. The weekly update has not been confirmed as received. The stated target is to complete mechanical and civil work by "the 18th" (month not stated) and return after the New Year for the remaining scope. Monday–Wednesday work next week is approved.
